rules.rationale: This proof-only rule asserts the general mathematical fact that slicing a string after two known leading codes yields its arbitrary symbolic tail. Stage 1 compiles the rule into VERIFICATION before proving the sole correctness claim, and prove.sh contains no earlier proof of this exact rule against a module that omits it, so the fact remains trusted.

This rule defines the named proof term #runDecimalToBinary by expanding it to a call of the closure whose body is the translated implementation; it is proof-harness definitional scaffolding rather than an additional mathematical fact.
